The closest match is Socially Aware Music Recommendation: A Multi-Modal Graph Neural Networks for Collaborative Music Consumption and Community-Based Engagement by Kajwan Ziaoddini. It uses a heterogeneous graph to model user-song interactions and user-user social relationships, and it is designed for socially aware music recommendation with community-based engagement [1].

If you meant a music graph recommendation method more broadly, this paper is the only one here that explicitly uses a graph neural network for music recommendation [1]. Other papers focus on multimodal sequential recommendation, mood or emotion-based recommendation, or generative/conversational systems rather than graph-based recommendation [2, 4, 6, 10].
